# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen  <sub>[v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017), [v1 c26 P15](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P16](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia
- **Role:** Schoolteacher
- **Titles:** Miss Harcourt; Tall Nell; Nell of Grey Shutters
- **Nicknames:** Nell  <sub>[v1 c12 P16](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0016)</sub>; Anne; Nell with an E  <sub>[v1 c12 P17](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0017)</sub>; Nell-girl

## Appearance

Nell is a tall, slender young woman with thick red hair and bright gray eyes. She has a delicate face with freckles on her nose and takes pride in her features, particularly her nose. After an unfortunate attempt to dye her hair, it temporarily turned a drab, bronzen green with red stripes before returning to normal.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P8](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0008), [v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P17](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0017), [v2 c20 P17](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0017)_

## Personality

Nell is bright, imaginative, deeply compassionate, and energetic. She possesses a vivid imagination that frequently leads her into dramatic daydreams and poetic creative writing. Highly principled, sensitive, and resolute, she works hard to master her flaws and feels deep remorse when her actions bring trouble or sorrow. Though prone to occasional stage fright and self-consciousness, she demonstrates remarkable composure and grace under pressure.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P17](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0017), [v1 c12 P20](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0020), [v1 c26 P10](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0010), [v1 c26 P12](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0012), [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 c27 P18](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0018), [v1 c33 P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v2 c20 P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023)_

- Imaginative and romantic  <sub>[v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013)</sub>

## Goals

- To remain at Grey Shutters permanently  <sub>[v1 c6 P23](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0023), [v1 c6 P28](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0028)</sub>
- To overcome her overactive imagination and focus on her duties

## History

Nell Harcourt came to Grey Shutters at the age of eleven when Obed and Thirza Abernethy took her in. Fearing she would be sent to live with the stern Mrs. Scobie, Nell pleaded passionately to stay and was ultimately accepted into the household. She developed a profound friendship with Isolde Pembroke, swearing a solemn lifelong vow of friendship with her in the Pembroke garden. Throughout her youth, Nell threw herself into creative writing, schooling, and helping Thirza with daily household chores. Despising her red hair, she once bought hair dye from an itinerant German merchant; the dye unexpectedly turned her hair green, driving her into temporary despair until Thirza helped resolve the situation. Over time, Nell took on significant responsibilities at Grey Shutters, including looking after the young twins Robin and Lucy Farrow. In public life, she participated in school events and concerts, occasionally suffering intense stage fright before rising to the occasion.
